milestone.name: K8.2 - Response Intention Planning Layer
milestone.summary: Freeze response intention planning that decides interaction goal, stance, depth, and context economy without generating final answer text.

review.name: K8.2 Response Intention Planning Contract Freeze

objective: Decide what kind of interaction Julia should create before generating language.
acceptance_targets: Defines Response Intention Object with primary goal, secondary goals, interaction mode, tone, depth, context need hints, and avoid behaviors.
Response Intention contains no final Julia answer text.
Response Intention is derived from K8.1 possible intents without collapsing uncertainty too early.
Response Intention supports multiple possible intents and confidence.
Response Intention distinguishes relationship confirmation from relationship fact dumping.
Response Intention distinguishes identity continuity repair from biography introduction.
Response Intention handles drift feedback as interaction repair, not defensive identity assertion.
Response Intention avoids unnecessary identity/relationship/experience activation for ordinary technical topics.
Response Intention includes Response Economy / Context Usage Efficiency.
Negative gates reject premature answer generation, intention template leak, and context over-selection.
K8.2 does not mutate Identity, Relationship, Memory, Experience, Re-entry, or Event artifacts.
K8.2 remains separate from K8.3 Context Need Optimization and Provider Generation.

metrics.RIQS: Goal Fit + Intent Preservation + Depth Appropriateness + Context Economy + Boundary Compliance - Premature Answer Risk - Template Risk - Context Over-selection Risk
metrics.CUE: Relevant Context Usage - Unnecessary Context Activation
